Heparin-Induced Thrombocytopenia: positive heparin-platelet factor 4 enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay (ELISA)
positive heparin-platelet factor 4 enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay (ELISA)

top_diagnoses.reasoning_summary: The patient presented with a low platelet count, which dropped significantly after exposure to heparin, and had a strongly positive heparin-platelet factor 4 enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay (ELISA). Additionally, the patient developed new or worsening thrombosis, as evidenced by severe ischemic changes in all toes and fingers.
